review_evidence: Cookbook/DataStructures/Trees/BinaryTree.lean defines BinaryTree, contains, insert, depth, totalWeight, and conversion/printing examples; RBTree.lean defines scheduler-style RBMap interfaces.

Cookbook/DataStructures/TOML/*.lean defines configuration structures, DecodeToml/ToToml instances, parsing, nested access, and file round trips; JSON recipes likewise define reusable serialization examples.

Cookbook/Syntax, Elaboration, Expressions, Tactics, MaintainingState, IO, and FileSystem contain concrete Lean declarations demonstrating metaprogramming and runtime interfaces, which are useful prior art.
summary: Retain the Lean metaprogramming cookbook because its recipes are executable formal examples of Lean APIs, data structures, syntax, elaboration, tactics, state, IO, and serialization.
